content: अनुवर्तनम् .²1 Following (<ab>fig.</ab> also); attending, compliance, obedience, conformity; प्रकृतस्यानुवर्तने <ls>Ak.</ls>; इदमाश्चर्यमथवा लोकस्थित्यनुवर्तनम् <ls>Mv. 7. 4</ls>; दाक्षिण्य˚ <ls>Dk. 161</ls>. .²2 Gratifying, obliging. .²3 Approval of, concurrence in. .²4 Continuance; result, consequence. .²5 Supplying from a preceding Sūtra.
